criteria.text: The participant is chemotherapy-naive and is planned to receive AC or cisplatin-based chemotherapy ≥70 mg/m² on Day 1 of each cycle, with no multiple administrations during the CINV observation period (Day 2 to Day 5 of each cycle).
The participant has an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 to 2.
The participant has symptomatic or untreated central nervous system (CNS) metastases.
The participant has an established diagnosis of uncontrolled diabetes mellitus.
The participant has a history of, or current evidence of, a clinically significant cardiac condition or QT/QTcF-related conditions.
The participant has another etiology for nausea and vomiting, or receives medications with known or potential antiemetic activity.
The participant has signs, symptoms, or a history of thyroid tumors.
The participant receives treatment with a gastric inhibitory polypeptide (GIP) or glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonist within 4 weeks prior to chemotherapy.

The participant has participated in a clinical study involving study intervention within 30 days of Cycle 1 Day 1 (C1D1), or within 3 months or 5 half-lives (whichever is longer) of C1D1 if the previous study intervention has a long half-life.
The participant is pregnant, breastfeeding, or intends to become pregnant during the study or within 30 days of the last dose of study intervention.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: These questions are about the trial "A Study to Evaluate LY3537021 for the Treatment of Nausea and Vomiting Caused by Chemotherapy in Adults With Cancer". Your earlier answers already covered 3 of its rules. I'll ask about the rest of its rules one at a time. You can skip any question, and "I don't know" is always fine.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Are you currently receiving chemotherapy, or do you have a plan to start it soon? Also, will your treatment include AC or cisplatin-based chemotherapy at a dose of 70 mg/m² or higher?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I'm so sorry, but I haven't had any chemotherapy yet. I definitely haven't had AC or cisplatin.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Will your upcoming treatment include AC or cisplatin-based chemotherapy at a dose of 70 mg/m² or higher? Also, will you only receive this chemo once per cycle, without extra doses between days 2 and 5?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I'm so sorry, but I don't know what my upcoming treatment will include yet. I haven't started anything, so I can't say for sure about the doses or schedule.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you ever been diagnosed with uncontrolled diabetes? If you aren't sure, that's okay to say.

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I'm so sorry, but I don't know if I have diabetes. I haven't been told about that, so I'm not sure.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you ever been diagnosed with a heart condition or an issue with your heart's electrical rhythm (QT/QTcF)? If you aren't sure, that's okay to say.

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I'm so sorry, but I don't know if I have a heart condition or an issue with my heart's rhythm. I haven't been told about that.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Are you currently taking any medications specifically to prevent or treat nausea and vomiting?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I'm so sorry, but I haven't started any treatment yet, so I'm not taking any medications for nausea or vomiting.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you ever been diagnosed with thyroid tumors, or do you have any signs or symptoms related to them? If you aren't sure, that's okay to say.

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I'm so sorry, but I don't know if I have thyroid tumors. I haven't been told about that, so I'm not sure.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you received any injections or medications for diabetes or weight loss that contain GIP or GLP-1 (like Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, or Trulicity) in the 4 weeks before your chemotherapy?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I'm so sorry, but I haven't started any treatment yet, so I haven't taken any of those injections. I'm not sure if I have diabetes or weight loss issues either.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you taken part in any other clinical trial or study involving a new treatment within the last 30 days?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I'm so sorry, but I haven't taken part in any other clinical trials. I haven't had any treatment yet, so I definitely haven't been in a study recently.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you, that's all my questions. Your record for this trial is ready, for you and your oncologist. They and the trial team decide whether it is right for you.
